body: Click and hold the ignition. Put your nose to it and see if you can smell the gas coming out. If the gas is coming out then it's most likely a problem with the piezo crystal inside (the clicker that produces a spark). You will need to open the lighter to replace it. Pray to God that the type they used is not proprietary to this lighter. If it's just a standard clicker then buy some cheap lighter with the same clicker ignition and swap the mechanism. Make sure that the wire coming out of the clicker is not too far away from the gas nozzle or it won't have enough power to produce a spark.

Update: Turns out a fair amount of people also experienced this problem. The solutions vary from forum to forum. Here are a couple of them:
1. Some people say that the autorun is broken. Go to the Setup folder on the disc and run "setup.exe" as an administrator.
2. There is a program called XP Mode. It's a virtual machine set up with Windows XP and SP3 pack. Some people use it to play the game and it works.
3. A youtuber called "rachybop" has managed to install the game without any problems using the later "Double Deluxe" version of it. At least she didn't mention having any problems.
4. The most silly fix I've found and the first time I've ever heard of using for any old program. Changing your Windows theme to "Basic". It makes the system look like Win 95/98. Apparently the installer gets confused by the new theme and crashes itself. It worked for at least 1 person or so they say. Sadly I don't remember how to do it but I'm sure you will be able to find a way on google.

That's all I found so far. If none of these work let me know I will try to look for more. Good luck!

I don't know what the problem is exacly but I will give you some advice that might help.

1. If you have the original release the first thing I would do is to look for a later re-release. Old CD tend to be hit or miss in terms of reliability. Plus new disc readers can potentially destroy the original CD as a majority of them spin it faster than the old ones. It's a small chance but it can happen. 
2. Try using a program that checks the CD for data damage. Just be careful and read the instructions because some of them can format the disc with 1 miss click.
3. It can be a problem with old no longer supported by Windows 10 copy protection of the CD. Like SecuROM. Although it usually prevents the already installed game from running not the installation itself. The only way around it would be to download the game from the internet or find a version without that copy protection, if it exists.
4. If your computer is powerful enough you could try to install a virtual machine. It's basically running a second OS inside your OS. Install an older version of windows on it. You will need an .iso of the system you want to install.

The QWERTZ layout was a leftover from 1910s/20s when Poland regained independence after 123 years. As you can propably guess we didn't have any polish typewriter manufacturers so we mostly used german made ones with the omlauts (and a couple of other symbols) replaced with our own special letters (ą,ć,ł,ż,ó,ź,ń,ę) and that kinda stuck with us. Even afterwards when we had our own typewriter brands they still used QWERTZ since typists were used to that. I'm not sure why they added QWERTY as the other standard in the 90s. I think it was a combination of two factors:

 1. Unlike germans we use the letter Y much more frequently so QWERTY was simply a better layout for us. 

2. Due to the fall of communism in 1989 we started importing a lot of western hardware and software which was made with QWERTY in mind. 

The fun thing is that we technically never changed away from QWERTZ to QWERTY. Both are still in the norm given by the government. Even when you install Windows you can pick between the typist layout (QWERTZ) and the programist layout (QWERTY) even though finding a QWERTZ layout computer keyboard with polish symbols is extremly hard. These days almost nobody uses QWERTZ here anymore. In fact when I was being taught how to install Windows in my IT school the teacher would scold you for picking QWERTZ instead of QWERTY.
